'''Hyperdrive Station A-226''' was a technical sector of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] known as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The stations' powerful [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] system was housed in that sector and monitored from there.<ref name="DSTC">[[Death Star Technical Companion (Second Edition)|''Death Star Technical Companion'', Second Edition]]</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The image used to represent Hyperdrive Station A-226 in the ''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]'' was actually a digitally-manipulated screenshot from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. [[Chris Trevas]] and [[Chris Reiff]] modified a picture of Vader and Tarkin facing a viewscreen so that they were looking at a view of the hyperspace tunnel.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-death-star-plans-are-now-in-your-hands|text=The Death Star Plans Are Now In YOUR Hands!|nolive=1}}</ref>
